Theme 054 · Signature directions

Agent Chat

The whole film is one conversation. The hook is a noisy team chat nobody answers; on the drop the thread clears and the agent arrives; the proof is the agent messaging first, with the anomaly rendered as a tool card inside its bubble and the human replying “Roll back”. Serif titles sit above the chat like film subtitles.

COMPONENT KIT

  • User bubble — right-aligned, ink fill, white text, sharp bottom-right corner
  • Agent bubble — left, white card with hairline + Acme mark avatar and a mono “ACME PULSE” label
  • Typing indicator — three dots pulsing on the beat; in the hook it dies unanswered
  • Tool card — coral header strip, giant mono number, sparkline with deploy rule, context line, action chips
  • System note — centred mono line (“you didn’t ask · Pulse started this”) that gives time and agency
  • Composer — pill input with teal send button; the CTA is styled as the final outgoing message

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Bubble pop — scale .9 → 1 + 30 px rise from its sender side, back.out(1.6) 0.3 s, one per beat (0.5 s at 120 BPM)
  • Thread scroll — older bubbles translate up by bubble height, power2.out 0.25 s, synced to each new pop
  • Tool-card unfold — height 0 → auto via clip-path over 0.5 s (power3.out) landing on a bar downbeat; chips stagger in 0.1 s apart

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

Chat is the native mental model for “an AI agent”, and a proactive first message is the clearest possible proof of a background agent. The risk is looking like every other chatbot demo — the tool card and the human decision must be visibly the hero, not the typing animation.

Adapt to your product: Replace the tool card with the richest result your product returns (a diff, a chart, a booking, a draft) and keep the pattern: the agent speaks first, the human answers with one decisive action.

References: https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/ai-sdk-ui/generative-user-interfaces (tool results rendered as components inside chat) · https://vercel.com/blog/ai-sdk-3-generative-ui (generative UI announcement with streaming components)
